test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Daring**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Daring means the quality of being brave and willing to take risks.

 -Example: He showed great **daring** on the battlefield.

Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in is 'Daring'.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• 'Strong' means having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks.
 
• 'Powerful' means having great power or strength.
 
• 'Thoughtful' means absorbed in or involving thought.
